\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
In the first scaling region, let $x=\omega/\Delta_+$; the transmission is
\begin{equation}
T(\omega)=x+0.\label{first-region}
\end{equation}
In the second scaling region, let $x=\omega/\Delta_-$; the transmission is
\begin{equation}
T(\omega)=x.\label{second-region}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
